name: caringmind-frame-relay
description: WebSocket frame relay server with WASM frame processing and session mp4 export

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../crate && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/frame-relay-target cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target bundler --out-dir ../server/pkg /tmp/frame-relay-target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/frame_relay_wasm.wasm
